## History

Alonzo is one of Aunt Jamesina's cats, brought along when she arrives to chaperone [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends at Patty's Place during their Sophomore year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). He joins the household alongside Aunt Jamesina's other cat, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), and the stray cat [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had previously adopted.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Home P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 ch.Home P9](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0009), +91 more_

## Relationships

### [Alec](../character/alec.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alonzo and [Alec](../character/alec.md) are rivals who compete directly for [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's romantic affections and ultimate choice in marriage. Their rivalry persists as [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) indecisively weighs her options between them while maintaining her social popularity.

- Rival of — rivals for Phil Gordon's affection and marriage choice  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alonzo--phil-gordon.md)

Alonzo is romantically involved with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) as one of the suitors she is actively considering for marriage. He remains in competition for her hand alongside her other admirer, [Alec](../character/alec.md), while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) navigates her choices and social life.

- Romantically involved with — suitor she is considering marrying  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052)</sub>
